observed_behavior: An archived inventory query filtered to appServer source omitted the exact worker created through the installed App Server.
expected_behavior: Archive recovery finds the original actor independently of the native session source label.
causal_mechanism: The runtime recorded the worker source as vscode. Creation transport and retained session source are distinct metadata boundaries.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Deriving a stored session source discriminator from the transport used to create the session.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Filtering with the inferred discriminator excludes a valid actor whose runtime source metadata differs.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Recovery uses the physical checkout and exact original actor identity without inferring source metadata from creation transport.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Include all supported native source kinds in the exact-checkout archived query, then match the original thread ID and validate returned checkout identities.

applicability_conditions: Transport identity and persisted session source are separate metadata.
Archived inventory is filtered by session source.
confirmation_evidence: The exact-checkout query including all supported kinds found the retired actor with source vscode while the appServer-only query returned false.
The final native retirement test passes with the source-independent query.
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-codex.integration.ts: live worker acknowledges retirement, becomes idle and reconciles archival of the same actor
tests/rolling-codex.test.ts: archive recovery uses paginated exact-checkout inventory and rejects an escaped physical root
